answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a seasoning period of verified useful work. A walnut-sized deposit is trivial for one honest agent but multiplies linearly with every fake identity, so a sybil farm pays the full sum up front while earning nothing during seasoning. If peers flag the identity, the stake is slashed, and the ripple of that penalty reaches the operator's other identities through shared funding traces. Identity creation stops being free and becomes a spiral of rising cost that outruns any reward from gaming the economy.
